tasks.label: build: docker image
tasks.command: if [ ! -x dist/mcp-context-manager ]; then mkdir -p dist; echo "dist/mcp-context-manager missing; building standalone binary..." >&2; docker run --rm -v "${workspaceFolder}:/workspace" -w /tmp/build python:3.12-bullseye sh -lc 'tar -C /workspace --exclude=.git --exclude=.mcp-context-manager --exclude=.pytest_cache --exclude=.ruff_cache --exclude=__pycache__ --exclude=build --exclude=dist --exclude=wheelhouse -cf - . | tar -C /tmp/build -xf - && apt-get update >/tmp/apt.log && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends binutils >>/tmp/apt.log && python -m pip install --upgrade pip >/tmp/pip.log && python -m pip install pyinstaller . >>/tmp/pip.log && pyinstaller --onefile --name mcp-context-manager --distpath /workspace/dist --workpath /tmp/pyinstaller-build --specpath /tmp --collect-all mcp_context_manager src/mcp_context_manager/__main__.py && chown -R "$(stat -c "%u:%g" /workspace)" /workspace/dist'; fi; docker build --build-arg SERVER_BINARY=dist/mcp-context-manager -t mcp-context-manager:local .

tasks.label: build: standalone executable
tasks.command: mkdir -p dist && docker run --rm -v "${workspaceFolder}:/workspace" -w /tmp/build python:3.12-bullseye sh -lc 'tar -C /workspace --exclude=.git --exclude=.mcp-context-manager --exclude=.pytest_cache --exclude=.ruff_cache --exclude=__pycache__ --exclude=build --exclude=dist --exclude=wheelhouse -cf - . | tar -C /tmp/build -xf - && apt-get update >/tmp/apt.log && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends binutils >>/tmp/apt.log && python -m pip install --upgrade pip >/tmp/pip.log && python -m pip install pyinstaller . >>/tmp/pip.log && pyinstaller --onefile --name mcp-context-manager --distpath /workspace/dist --workpath /tmp/pyinstaller-build --specpath /tmp --collect-all mcp_context_manager src/mcp_context_manager/__main__.py && chown -R "$(stat -c "%u:%g" /workspace)" /workspace/dist'

tasks.label: build: docker image tar.gz
tasks.command: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p dist; if [ ! -x dist/mcp-context-manager ]; then echo "dist/mcp-context-manager is missing; building standalone binary..." >&2; docker run --rm -v "${workspaceFolder}:/workspace" -w /tmp/build python:3.12-bullseye sh -lc 'tar -C /workspace --exclude=.git --exclude=.mcp-context-manager --exclude=.pytest_cache --exclude=.ruff_cache --exclude=__pycache__ --exclude=build --exclude=dist --exclude=wheelhouse -cf - . | tar -C /tmp/build -xf - && apt-get update >/tmp/apt.log && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends binutils >>/tmp/apt.log && python -m pip install --upgrade pip >/tmp/pip.log && python -m pip install pyinstaller . >>/tmp/pip.log && pyinstaller --onefile --name mcp-context-manager --distpath /workspace/dist --workpath /tmp/pyinstaller-build --specpath /tmp --collect-all mcp_context_manager src/mcp_context_manager/__main__.py && chown -R "$(stat -c "%u:%g" /workspace)" /workspace/dist'; fi; docker build --build-arg SERVER_BINARY=dist/mcp-context-manager -t mcp-context-manager:local .; docker save mcp-context-manager:local | gzip -9 > dist/mcp-context-manager-local-image.tar.gz

tasks.label: build: local release artifacts
tasks.command: set -euo pipefail; if [ ! -x dist/mcp-context-manager ]; then echo 'dist/mcp-context-manager is missing; run the standalone build task first.' >&2; exit 1; fi; (cd dist && sha256sum mcp-context-manager mcp-context-manager-local-image.tar.gz > SHA256SUMS)
